capabilities.name: Local Model Chat
capabilities.description: Send chat prompts to the configured local model runtime.

capabilities.name: Local Model Tool Calls
capabilities.description: Allow the local model to plan tool calls.

capabilities.name: Remote Model Chat
capabilities.description: Send prompts to a remote model provider.

capabilities.name: Remote Model Planning
data_exposed: local model attempt and uncertainty signal
excluded_by_default: session conversation outside the current task
capabilities.description: Escalate a task to a remote model for structured planning. Each plan step is validated against the active harness before local execution. Distinct from model.remote.chat because the planner influences local execution paths, not only the user-facing response.

capabilities.name: Session Memory Read
capabilities.description: Read ephemeral in-process session memory.

capabilities.name: Session Memory Write
capabilities.description: Write ephemeral in-process session memory.

capabilities.name: Durable Memory Write
capabilities.description: Persist durable memory beyond the current session.

capabilities.name: Provenance Read
capabilities.description: Read the in-process provenance log.

capabilities.name: Provenance Clear
capabilities.description: Clear the in-process provenance log.

capabilities.name: Cognitive Load Assessment
capabilities.description: Assess submitted text for non-diagnostic cognitive-load stewardship signals.

capabilities.name: Desktop Accessibility Tree Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded desktop accessibility environment, application root objects, and shallow child role/count metadata without actuation.

capabilities.name: Desktop Window Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect window-level accessibility metadata beyond the root-object sample.

capabilities.name: Focused Desktop Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect currently focused desktop or accessibility object metadata.

capabilities.name: Desktop Text Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect text content, child names, descriptions, or other potentially sensitive UI text.

capabilities.name: Scoped File Read

capabilities.description: Read text files within granted read scopes.

capabilities.name: Scoped File Write
capabilities.description: Write files within a granted scope.

capabilities.name: Shell Command Execution
capabilities.description: Run shell commands on the host.

capabilities.name: Camera Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect camera or video input.

capabilities.name: Microphone Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect microphone input.

capabilities.name: Screen Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect screen or application state.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Color Stream Subscription
data_exposed: JPEG-encoded color frames from a remote Sensorium publisher
scene contents within the camera's field of view
capabilities.description: Subscribe to JPEG-encoded color frames from a remote Sensorium publisher node over the local Zenoh fabric. Subscription itself is droppable; consumption into the model's working context is one-way at the model boundary. See docs/concepts/drafts/sensorium_integration.md for the full integration shape.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Depth Stream Subscription
data_exposed: PNG-encoded 16-bit depth maps from a remote Sensorium publisher
spatial structure of the scene within the depth sensor's field of view
capabilities.description: Subscribe to PNG-encoded 16-bit depth maps from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Each payload carries a depth_units field (meters per raw sample) so consumers can convert to physical distance. Camera-class capability; model-boundary irreversibility applies.

capabilities.name: Sensorium IMU Stream Subscription
data_exposed: device-frame motion of the sensor node
capabilities.description: Subscribe to accelerometer and gyroscope samples from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Device-frame motion only; no orientation or position fusion is performed by the producer. Rate is matched to the slowest video stream when video is also enabled — see Sensorium ROADMAP 5f for the matcher caveat.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Location Subscription
excluded_by_default: remote export of location to third parties
remote-routing context inclusion without separate consent
capabilities.description: Subscribe to static location samples from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Current producer publishes operator-configured coordinates with source="static"; a future GPS-backed publisher would emit the same payload shape with source="gps". Treated as Sensitive even in identity-only mode (site label, no coordinates) because the channel can be upgraded without consumer-side code change.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Status Subscription
data_exposed: list of stream topic tails the remote node is advertising
capabilities.description: Subscribe to liveness and discovery metadata from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Carries node identity and the list of stream tails the node is advertising, so consumers can detect liveness and learn what to subscribe to without enumerating the topic namespace. Lowest-risk Sensorium capability and the recommended first wiring slice.
